notes: Source: official Yealink MeetingBar A30 datasheet PDF (manufacturer, yealink.com). The datasheet also lists an "HDMI input" but it is only available via the optional external VCH51 Sharing Kit dongle, not a native physical port on the base A30 unit, so it was omitted. "Motion sensor", "Security lock slot", and "Reset slot" are listed in the datasheet but are not signal/power connectors, so omitted. The "Yealink extension port (RJ-45)" is a proprietary port for connecting accessories (e.g. CTP18 touch panel) — RJ45 connector but not confirmed standard graded Ethernet, so no eth-grade set. Power connector is a proprietary barrel-style DC jack (closest standard id: dc-barrel); external adapter: AC 100-240V input, DC 48V/0.7A output. This is an all-in-one Android video collaboration bar (integrated camera/mic/speaker/compute) for Microsoft Teams/Zoom — no exact category/type match exists in the given enums (no "video conferencing bar" option), so category was set to "other" and type to "Video switcher" as the closest available fit; treat both as best-effort. Desktop/wall/TV-mount unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: Extension Port
ports.note: Yealink proprietary extension port for accessories (e.g. CTP18 touch panel); not a standard Ethernet data port, so no speed grade assigned

ports.name: Power
ports.note: Proprietary Yealink power port; external power adapter converts AC 100-240V input to DC 48V/0.7A output
